content.name: Darnell Harper
content.title: Principal DevOps Engineer
content.summary: Principal DevOps engineer with 15 years moving from Linux administration to running cloud platforms for health and insurance software. Leads a seven-person platform team supporting 140 developers on AWS and Kubernetes, and cut annual cloud spend by $1.1 million without slowing delivery. Comfortable with HIPAA and SOC 2 audits.

experience.title: Systems Administrator
bullets: Administered 600 Linux servers for small-business hosting customers and kept the shared platform at 99.9% monthly uptime.
Replaced hand-edited configs with Puppet, so new servers went from a day of setup to under an hour.
Rotated through overnight on-call and wrote the escalation guide still in use when I left.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
bullets: Moved the order platform from a colocation rack to AWS over nine months with a single planned two-hour maintenance window.
Built Jenkins pipelines that took the team from monthly releases to several deploys a day.
Set up autoscaling for holiday peaks that handled four times normal order volume at Thanksgiving with no outage.
Introduced centralized logging with the ELK stack, cutting average time to diagnose incidents from about an hour to 15 minutes.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
bullets: Designed the Terraform module library for a HIPAA-regulated analytics platform spanning 45 AWS accounts.
Migrated 70 services from EC2 to Amazon EKS, improving average node utilization from 22% to 61%.
Automated evidence collection for SOC 2 Type II, reducing audit prep from six weeks to ten days.
Coached three engineers through their first production on-call rotations.

experience.title: Principal DevOps Engineer
bullets: Lead a seven-person platform team serving 140 developers, owning Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability and developer tooling.
Cut annual AWS spend by $1.1 million through Savings Plans, Graviton migration and deleting idle environments.
Rolled out Argo CD and a golden-path service template, shortening new-service setup from two weeks to one day.
Established incident review and SLO practices across 12 teams; Sev-1 incidents fell from 11 in 2022 to 3 in 2025.
Manage a $2.4 million annual platform budget and the vendor relationships behind it.

achievements.title: Speaker, Denver DevOps meetup
achievements.detail: Talk on FinOps habits for engineering teams, later shared internally as a training module.

achievements.title: Open-source contributor
achievements.detail: Merged fixes to two widely used Terraform providers.
